name: un-editorial-check
description: Reads user-visible copy the way a UN editor would: language, wording, tone, spelling, terminology, dates, numbers, claims and register. Report-first, with a conservative opt-in fixer.

scripts.test: node tests/run.mjs && node tests/release-regressions.mjs && node tests/portability-frontmatter.mjs && node scripts/validate-portability.mjs
scripts.check:syntax: node --check bin/check.mjs && for f in lib/*.mjs tests/*.mjs scripts/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
